description_en: Stops the execution of a playbook and its sub-playbooks
description_zh: 停止执行剧本及其子剧本
kebab_example: aliyun sophonsoar abort-playbook-execution --playbook-execution-uuid e776dab31-499b-4307-9248-xxxxxx --playbook-uuid system_aliyun_firewall_process_book --api-version 2025-09-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AbortPlaybookExecution

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator switches to when viewing from another member's perspective
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。取值：

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the playbook. The actual value is a descriptive identifier string (such as system_aliyun_firewall_process_book). You can obtain this value by calling the ListPlaybooks operation
parameters.help_zh: 剧本的标识。实际取值为描述性标识字符串（例如system_aliyun_firewall_process_book），可通过ListPlaybooks接口获取
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的 ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the task was stopped successfully. Valid values:

true: Stopped successfully.
false: Failed to stop
Success.description_zh:
任务停止是否成功。取值：

true：成功停止。
false：未成功停止
